hazenCNote: C = 140 for polyethylene per the Hunter (PE 3408, ASTM D2239) and Rain Bird (PE SDR pressure-rated tube) friction-loss charts; many EU designers use 150 for new PE - 140 is the conservative manufacturer value.
velocityNote: maxVelocity 1.5 m/s (5 ft/s): Hunter and Rain Bird friction charts shade velocities above 5 ft/s ("use with caution"); Rain Bird drip tubing chart: above 5 ft/s (1.5 m/s) not recommended. maxVelocityHard 2.3 m/s (7.5 ft/s): Rain Bird valve recommendation / service-line limit - treat as an error threshold.
